subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3262
title: Establishes the Oregon Wildfire Preparedness and Community Protection Fund and directs the State Fire Marshal, the State Forestry Department and the Oregon Watershed Enhancement Board to make expenditures from the fund for various activities related to restoration, protection and recovery from wildfires.

claims.text: HB 3262 was introduced in the House on January 21, 2025.
